# RC53 — Direct bookmark cycling

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/wscrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc g ]` / `core.next-bookmark` / `Next Bookmark`.
- Added `Esc g [` / `core.previous-bookmark` / `Previous Bookmark`.
- Direct bookmark navigation cycles through source bookmarks without opening the bookmark picker.
- From an unmarked location, next jumps to the first bookmark and previous jumps to the last bookmark.
- From a marked location, navigation wraps cyclically; empty and singleton-current states report in the footer.
- Direct bookmark jumps restore the target buffer/file and cursor, record the origin in jump history, and retain the RC52 path-only session persistence boundary.
- Updated README and the iPad QA matrix to cover direct bookmark cycling.
